title: Blackboard plan-epoch archive write failure runtime event payload v0.2
description: F7 (2026-08-15, BACKLOG 6e 复查遗留 / ADR-0010 §14.15): a blackboard plan-epoch snapshot could not be persisted after bounded retries. The plan rotation / live-board revision already committed in memory, but the durable archive is missing — this event is the audit trace. `kind` distinguishes the rotated OLD epoch snapshot (lost archive on rotation) from the CURRENT epoch persistence (approval/revision; the restore entry is weakened).

archive_dir.description: The configured blackboard archive directory the snapshot was written to.

plan_epoch.description: The epoch whose snapshot failed to persist (timestamp-stamped monotonic identity, ≥ 1).

kind.description: Which write failed: `rotated` = the old epoch archived during a rotation; `current` = the live epoch persisted at approval/revision.

attempts.description: Bounded retry attempts exhausted before giving up.
